bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than A4 size (30 cm x 21 cm x 10 cm) are not allowed into the Johan Cruijff ArenA.
allowed: Bags up to A4 size (30 x 21 x 10 cm)
prohibited: Bags larger than A4 (30 x 21 x 10 cm)
Animals, except service and guide dogs
bagPolicy.note: The house rules apply to all events, including concerts.

parking.note: Parking can be reserved in advance to ensure a good spot near the stadium. The venue is easily accessible by both car and public transport.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Johan Cruijff ArenA. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The Johan Cruijff ArenA offers a variety of food and drink options, including refreshing beverages and snacks available at kiosks. Notable dining experiences include Restaurant ON5TH by Lute®, Glasgow '72 Lounge, and House of Legends, which offers Indonesian cuisine.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you will use a wheelchair during the event, choose a wheelchair-accessible seat when you buy. These always include one seat for a companion.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not possible. Your ticket expires as soon as you leave the area it gives you access to.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Concert tickets are sold by the event organizer, not the Johan Cruijff ArenA, so contact the organizer with ticket questions. If your ticket can be printed, bring a printed copy in case your phone battery runs out.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The escalators are located at several entrances: main entrance E and entrances A, C, G, J and M.
